description: Team LunarX from Pakistan — building an Interactive 3D Lunar Mission Browser using real NASA data (LRO, CLPS, LOLA DEM). We visualize lunar landing sites, payloads & water ice on a realistic 3D Moon. Skills: Python, JavaScript, Three.js, Data Viz, AI. Let's map the Moon together! 🌕🚀
summary: LunarSite AI is an interactive 3D mission planning dashboard built for the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser challenge. It visualizes NASA's upcoming Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) missions alongside historical Apollo landing sites on a realistic 3D Moon using NASA's LRO textures. The platform features an AI-based scoring engine that evaluates landing sites based on Water Ice, Sunlight, Terrain, and Science value. It also includes a What-If Simulator, Mission Comparison tool, live NASA API integration (Space Weather, ISS Tracker, Pakistan Solar Data, Moon Phase), and a Rescue Mode with continuous SOS alarms for astronaut safety. With voice commands and Cinematic Story Mode, LunarSite AI makes lunar mission planning accessible and engaging for everyone.
details: LunarSite AI is a web-based 3D mission planning platform. It uses NASA LRO textures to render a realistic 3D Moon where users can explore upcoming CLPS missions and historical Apollo sites. Clicking on a mission reveals an AI-powered score (0-100) based on four parameters: Water Ice (35%), Sunlight (25%), Terrain (25%), and Science (15%). The platform includes a What-If Simulator for custom site testing, a Comparison tool for side-by-side mission analysis, and live data integration from NASA APIs (Space Weather, APOD, ISS Tracker, Pakistan Solar Data, Moon Phase). A Rescue Mode provides astronaut safety features with exact coordinates and continuous alarms. Built with Three.js, Vanilla JavaScript, Web Speech API, and jsPDF. The project addresses the challenge by making landing site selection transparent and visual, helping scientists and the public understand where and why CLPS missions land.
